name: Drupal WhatsApp
description: Embeds a hosted ChatWith.io / tochat.be WhatsApp chat widget on the site by placing a block that loads the vendor's bundle.js keyed by a Key entity.
project_description: The WhatsApp ("WhatsApp Widget") module embeds a hosted, third-party WhatsApp chat/click-to-chat widget onto the site. It does NOT talk to WhatsApp's Business API and does not send messages server-side. Instead it provides a single core Block plugin ("WhatsApp block") that renders `<script defer src="//widget.tochat.be/bundle.js?key=WIDGET_KEY"></script>`, where WIDGET_KEY is a widget identifier issued by the ChatWith.io / tochat.be SaaS and stored in a Key entity (the `key` module is a hard dependency). The vendor's JavaScript then draws the floating chat button/widget in the visitor's browser. Configuration lives at /admin/config/services/whatsapp behind the restricted `whatsapp configuration form` permission: an admin picks the Key that holds the widget key and, optionally, enables "Locally cache external library" so the bundle.js is downloaded to public://whatsapp/bundle.js (refreshed daily on cron) and served from the site instead of from the vendor CDN. Developed and maintained by Cambrico; sponsored by ChatWith.io.
